[b]Book of Korvald is OUT NOW on Steam! [/b]Book of Korvald tells the saga of a Norse scribe, and his alliance with a parasitic eldritch entity. Join forces with beautiful warrior nuns, sexy mythical figures and lustful interdimensional creatures to prevent our world from being devoured. Can you contain your sexual urges and fight to survive? 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/d3c80a887ca8238abdab5c93b2d5b5898a832691.png[/img]

Book of Korvald tells the saga of a Norse scribe, and his alliance with an eldritch entity named "Qhroth'un".

History does not tell us that Norse clans had scribes of their own. Their folklore is said to have been preserved through oral traditions exclusively, but this is not the truth. Many written sagas were damaging to the reputation of royal families and expository to the church. So these writings, along with their authors, were aggressively purged from existence. Korvald was one such scribe.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/15b48123089c8e96badd36a288b47601ddd51a32.png[/img]
Korvald's is not a tale of heroism and justice, but of deceit and suffering provoked by powerful religious empires and unseen cosmic forces. His story begins as so many are ended. Family slain and taken from his now destroyed village, Korvald is branded as a heretic and seemingly condemned to death. The true purpose of his capture and torment are part of a much bigger and far more sinister agenda. In his darkest hour, Korvald is approached by Qhroth'un and an agreement is made that will change everything...

- Each chapter takes place across an entire country, spanning over 30 areas. Starting in Denmark near the city of Ribe, drawing inspiration from the conversion to Christianity that took place around the 9th century in Scandinavia.

[b]Weapons:[/b]
- 200+ different weapons to find or buy from various shops. Axes, Swords, Maces, Whips, Spears, Flails, Daggers, Shields, and Books (yes books).

[b]Runes:[/b]

Utilizing his unique insight into this powerful language, he will gain the ability to harness many destructive and helpful forces. Unleash flaming cyclones, lightning storms, arctic blizzards, healing waters and even summon eldritch creatures to aid you in combat.

notes.title: If You Game Is Crashing, This Is How To Fix It
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/288080/BoneTown_The_Second_Coming_Edition/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/d174ac7f3ac6c3c1a92f48e585e36b0f788e4fa0.jpg[/img]

We are seeing a lot of people having issues with the game crashing when they enter a new location or try to access some of the new content.

There is a very easy solution to this. The crashes are happening due to Mods you have subscribed to through Steam Workshop.

To fix this issue. 

1. Unsubscribe from all of your Mods. You can right click on the BoneTown icon where you usually start the game and go to the Properties option. In this window, go to the Workshop tab. Here you can see all of the MODs you are subscribed to. Unsubscribe from all of them.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/749d94243eaf72db11ace6f61d23764c7b2012dd.jpg[/img]

2. If it doesn't work, you make need to go to the File Explorer and go to the follow path:
C:\ProgramFiles(x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\BoneTown\

3. Delete the "workshop" folder

4. Go to the "\game" folder and delete the "MODS" folder

5. Don't open the game yet, uninstall the game and download it again without anything from the workshop.

We have updated all of the MODs we created, but we have no control over when the creators of the other MODs will update their content to work with the new Kinks DLC stuff.

We apologize for this inconvenience. We really want to support the Workshop community, but it bring lots of other issues with it.

We hope this helps anyone who is having issue playing the Kinks DLC.

It’s been a while, so we thought we’d give you guys an update on what we’ve been working on for the future of BoneTown.

notes.title: Episode One is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/d899760efb18a84c9b4d515a1aba75ad46a9cac3.jpg[/img]

Episode One is here! To celebrate, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/288080/BoneTown_The_Second_Coming_Edition/]BoneTown is back on sale[/url][/b]!

If you already have the game, what do you need to do to get it? Nothing. It might already be downloaded--just check your download page and see. If it's not, try restarting Steam and that should get it.

Once you have it, you'll need to find the new content. Below is a description of where you can start all the new stuff:

[h3]Episode One: MiniDog and WeeWee[/h3]
This mission can be started in two places. The first is in the Havajo Indian Reservation, right outside the Casino. The second place you can start this mission is in Downtown, right outside the movie theater, and right across the street from the La Migra Headquarters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/dc0f96ff1b65ca04f7eb25de9abb0f010ebf497d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/522ec12d7cd0314cc86e6fccba9dc397768ac310.jpg[/img]

[h3]Amish Crackhead and the new Crackpipe[/h3]
This can be found in Downtown, right down the street from the movie theater where Episode One can be started. If you go from the movie theater towards Golden Rod Gym (where all the rockers are), you will pass the Catholic Church. Halfway between the Catholic Church and Golden Rod Gym, the Amish Crackhead and his woman can be found hanging out on the sidewalk. They are on the opposite side of the street from the Church and Gym.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/4b2e50ddbc872f16e02e5d60ffdeed1739acdada.jpg[/img]

[h3]Angelica the Angel[/h3]
This is started in Downtown by jumping on top of the Catholic Church behind the movie theater. Jump onto the crest of the two-sided pitched roof. Then walk to the very edge of this roof, so you're looking out over the water. There should appear a text box telling you to jump to the cloud to start the mission. From there, you jump to the closest cloud you can see, hovering over the street in front of you

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/6f803254d382b2b30c565393a4eadcf8c1dcabd7.jpg[/img]

We hope you guys enjoy the new content and we hope to have more new stuff for you soon.

notes.title: What's In Episode One
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/c0d650ae61bd8f4baf950b1083274d61b8f43957.jpg[/img]

We're only two days away from the release of Episode One, and we thought it'd be a good time to give you guys a sneak peak at what to expect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/3d9ceac3c4687bcf84894c82529478be0e5aad49.jpg[/img]

Episode One sees you crossing streams with BoneTown's drunkest little person, Minidog. At the end of a long night of trouble making at the Havajo Casino, Minidog is in need of a little assistance, and after some ass kicking, he decides it's time to get his bone on. You two head to Downtown and the Sticky Isles Movie Theater, which is a brand new interior space that will now be accessible anytime in downtown. 

After getting down to business with Minidog, you run into Sticky Isle's most notorious patron, WeeWee. An avid public jerker, he quickly takes a dislike to you and things escalate from there. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/ebe5965e7b550f491908da09280d9ff479a7b621.jpg[/img]

Also included in Episode One is Hezekiah, the Amish Drug Runner for BoneTown with his new and improved crackpipe. Along with Hezekiah, we also have added Angelica, otherwise known as the Angel Girl.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/4b190a73d9d0af1941b480addea5401538e4521d.jpg[/img]

[h2]EPISODE ONE CONTENT[/h2]

[list]
[*] Episode One: Minidog and WeeWee
[*] New Interior Space: Sticky Isles Movie Theater
[*] Two new playable characters: WeeWee and Hezekiah
[*] Two New Girls: Angelica the Angel, Hezekiah's Wife

[*] New Crackpipe that lasts twice as long

[*]Price: FREE

notes.title: New Save Option and Final Mission Balance Changes
notes.content:
BALANCE CHANGES:
Added a Save Game option to the In Game Menu. Now you can save your game wherever you are. The save points are still in the world, but you don't have to go to them anymore to save your game.

Now in the final mission, there is a halfway save point. Once you make it inside the Needle on the Man Island, you will warp back there even when you leave the Man Island and come back.

BUG FIXES:
Fixed a bug where after beating the game the wrong number of chapter stars appeared in Downtown on the mini-map and in the world.

Fixed a bug where you might stay in the final mission after dying.

Fixed a bug where the In Game Menu was not centered on larger resolution screens.

notes.title: Confirm for going to the Main Menu, Balance Changes and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/ccee59a9e6d0efe414685c4863faaf1aad4e77b4.jpg[/img]

BALANCE CHANGES:
While in the game, now when you bring the menu up and you press either Main Menu, or Exit Game, you will have to confirm 'Yes,' or 'No.' This will hopefully cause less people accidentally pressing these and loosing their save progress without a confirmation.

A delay has been added in the Jailbreak Competition when you knock out a La Migra agent. So now, when a La Migra agent is knocked out, he will not come back immediately, but in some random span of time.

Ron's Penetration Pound Off got a little easier.

Further decreased the AI's ability to see you when you are invisible in the Spirit Realm.

On high, we doubled the Shadow Resolution for the character shadows. 

BUG FIXES:
The Rubbin' Hood (Hod Chick) achievements will now work.

Fixed minor spelling errors in the text.

notes.title: Stun-lock Solution and Easy Just Got Easier
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/ccee59a9e6d0efe414685c4863faaf1aad4e77b4.jpg[/img]

BALANCE CHANGES:
1. [b]While on Shrooms*, you will now be immune to getting stunned.[/b] So when attacked by a bunch of dudes (or just one) while you're on Shrooms*, you no longer are just health immune, but also stun immune. We hope this helps people who were having issues with being attacked by too many guys. We also have a feeling Shrooms just got a proper place in the game along side the other super useful drugs like weed and crack.

2. Speaking of drugs being as useful as possible, [b]we also made a small change to Peyote.[/b] Before, while you were invisible, there was a small radius that, if the AI came within it, they could see you (sense you, if you will). Well, that radius just shrunk big time. They'll technically still be able to sense you, but only from a very small distance. We hope this makes Peyote and the Spirit World more useful as a way of dropping people who are fighting you.

3. [b]When you're playing on Easy, all of the Chapters will now be a lot easier.[/b] We heard that people were having to lower their character count to get through missions, and that just ain't right, so we fixed it. We lowered the number of characters attacking you, but also lowered the number of random people walking around (even when you have the game on max character count), so there will be a lot less of bringing random people into your fight by accidentally hitting them. We also made certain characters easier and made a few other tweaks to make sure that Easy was just that.

BUG FIXES:
You can now get first place in Tourist Bang in Downtown.


* In the game, we mean, for all you crazy fuckers who try everything in real life.
